# Review report template

```
Reviewed: screen or PR, state, viewport, theme, role, build or commit, date
Top tasks: 1) ... 2) ... 3) ...

Decision: SHIP / SHIP AFTER FIXES / DO NOT SHIP  (reason in one line)

Ratings (1 to 5, one line of evidence each)
R1 Task fit: _  evidence
R2 Hierarchy and scanning: _  evidence
R3 Consistency and reuse: _  evidence
R4 States and recovery: _  evidence
R5 Accessibility and input: _  evidence
R6 Content and terminology: _  evidence
R7 Simplicity: _  evidence
R8 Craft and distinctiveness: _  evidence
Mean (informative): _

Findings (highest severity first)
| # | Sev | Where | Evidence | Guide section | Fix | Effort |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

Preferences (not defects)
- ...

Checks run: commands, viewports, themes, states injected, keyboard path
Not checked, and why:
Fix pass (if done): before -> after numbers
```
